commands.name: tool.select
commands.label: Select
commands.description: Pick the select tool: click to select, drag to move, drag on empty space for a marquee.

commands.name: tool.text
commands.label: Text box
commands.description: Pick the text box tool: drag on the slide to place one.

commands.name: tool.rect
commands.label: Rectangle
commands.description: Pick the rectangle tool: drag on the slide to place one.

commands.name: tool.roundrect
commands.label: Rounded rectangle
commands.description: Pick the rounded rectangle tool: drag on the slide to place one.

commands.name: tool.ellipse
commands.label: Ellipse
commands.description: Pick the ellipse tool: drag on the slide to place one.

commands.name: tool.triangle
commands.label: Triangle
commands.description: Pick the triangle tool: drag on the slide to place one.

commands.name: tool.line
commands.label: Line
commands.description: Pick the line tool: drag on the slide to place one.

commands.name: tool.arrow
commands.label: Arrow
commands.description: Pick the arrow tool: drag on the slide to place one.

commands.name: tool.table
commands.label: Table
commands.description: Pick the table tool: click for a 3 by 3 table, or drag to size one.

commands.name: deck.read
commands.label: Read deck
commands.description: Read the deck as a compact list: each slide's id, number, layout, notes and elements (id, kind, box, placeholder type, text, table cells, image alt). Optional slides narrows it.

commands.name: slide.snapshot
commands.label: Snapshot slide
commands.description: A PNG of one slide, for an agent to look at. maxSize caps the long edge in px (default 960). Returns { dataUrl, width, height }.

commands.name: view.snapshot
commands.label: Snapshot view
commands.description: What the person sees: a PNG of the current slide (or the slide given), at most 1024 px wide, with a text summary of its elements, to check work before finishing. Returns { dataUrl, width, height, summary }. Same picture as slide.snapshot.

maxSize.description: Longest edge in px (default and most 1024)

commands.name: doc.describe
commands.label: Describe deck
commands.description: The whole deck in one compact read, for planning: name, size, theme, layouts, then every slide with its id, number, layout, notes and elements (id, kind, box, placeholder type, text). Cut to about 12000 characters on a large deck (truncated: true); then read the rest with deck.read and slides.

commands.name: icon.search
commands.label: Find icons
commands.description: Find icons by word ("sun", "chart", "user"): returns { icons: [{ name, label }] }, best matches first. Use a name with element.add kind icon, props.icon.

commands.name: layout.list
commands.label: List layouts
commands.description: The slide layouts this deck offers, in menu order: id, name and placeholders (id, type title|subtitle|body|content|picture|date|footer|slideNumber). content takes text or, through placeholder.fill, a table or picture.

commands.name: theme.list
commands.label: List themes
commands.description: The built-in themes (id, name, colours, fonts) and the deck's current theme.

commands.name: deck.find
commands.label: Find text
commands.description: Find slides and elements whose text or notes contain `query` (case-insensitive). Returns [{ slide, element?, inNotes?, text }].

commands.name: file.new
commands.label: New
commands.description: Show the New page (blank or a template).

commands.name: file.open
commands.label: Open
commands.description: Show the Open page: Recent, then the decks in storage, then Browse this computer.

commands.name: file.save
commands.label: Save
commands.description: Save the deck where it lives (NakliOS storage when hosted). A new deck is saved under its name in NakliOS storage, or in this browser when not hosted. Never opens a picker.

commands.name: file.save_as
commands.label: Save As
commands.description: Save under a new name; the copy becomes the deck you are editing. kind is naklios (hosted) or browser (standalone), default where it is now. A name already taken fails unless replace is true. Saving to this computer needs a person (File, Save As…). From the menu or palette with no name, it opens the Save as dialog.

replace.description: Overwrite a deck with this name

commands.name: file.export
commands.label: Export
commands.description: Export a copy in another format; the deck stays where it is. Hosted, the copy goes to NakliOS storage under exports/; otherwise it downloads. pdf, notes and handouts open the print dialog and need a person.

format.description: pptx, png, html, markdown, pdf, notes or handouts

commands.name: file.info
commands.label: File info
commands.description: The current deck's name, where it is saved, and whether it has unsaved changes.

commands.name: file.print
commands.label: Print
commands.description: Print the deck: one slide per page in the browser print dialog (choose "Save as PDF" for a PDF). Needs a person.

commands.name: deck.new
commands.label: New deck
commands.description: Start a new deck (alias of file.new: with no input a person gets the New page). With size (16:9 or 4:3), theme (a theme id) or name, or from an agent, it starts the deck at once; the current one stays in its file and in the recovery copy.

commands.name: deck.open
commands.label: Open…
commands.description: Show the Open page (alias of file.open): .pellucia decks, deck .json, PowerPoint and Markdown files from NakliOS storage or this computer.

commands.name: deck.save
commands.label: Save
commands.description: Save the deck where it lives (alias of file.save). name renames the deck's file first. Never opens a picker.

name.description: New file name (default: keep the current one)

commands.name: deck.export
commands.label: Export…
commands.description: Export a copy of the deck (the deck stays where it lives): format pdf (the browser print dialog, one slide per page; needs a person), notes or handouts (print dialog too), png (one slide, or every slide as a ZIP), pptx (PowerPoint), markdown (Marp, text only), html (one file that presents without Pellucia) or pellucia (a copy of the deck file). slides limits it to some slides. scale is 1 to 3 for png. Returns where it went.

format.description: pdf, png, pptx, pellucia, notes (notes pages PDF), handouts (PDF, perPage 1, 2, 3, 4, 6 or 9), markdown (Marp) or html (a self-contained deck that presents)

slides.description: Only these slides (default: all, hidden ones skipped for pdf and png)

commands.name: deck.set
commands.label: Deck settings
commands.description: Set the deck name and footer: footer { text, date, showNumber, showDate, skipFirst (no footer on the first slide) }.

skipFirst.description: Hide the footer on the first slide

commands.name: deck.resize
commands.label: Slide size
commands.description: Change the slide size: 16:9 (1920x1080) or 4:3 (1440x1080). Elements scale with the stage.

commands.name: theme.apply
commands.label: Apply theme
commands.description: Apply a theme to the whole deck: a built-in theme id (theme.list), or { colors: { bg, text, heading, muted, accent1..accent6 as #rrggbb }, fonts: { heading, body } } to change parts. Elements that use theme colours and fonts change with it.

heading.description: sans, serif, mono or a font family

body.description: sans, serif, mono or a font family

commands.name: slide.add
commands.label: New slide
commands.description: Add a slide after `after` (default: the current slide) with a layout (layout.list; default title-content). Optional title and body fill its title and body placeholders (body: one bullet per line). Returns { id }.

body.description: Plain text (one paragraph per line; "- " starts a bullet, "1. " a numbered item) or a rich Text { paras: [{ runs: [{ t, b, i, u, s, color, size, font, hl, link }], list, level, align }] }

commands.name: slide.delete
commands.label: Delete slide
commands.description: Delete slides and everything on them (undo brings them back). A deck keeps at least one slide.

commands.name: slide.move
commands.label: Move slide
commands.description: Move slides to position `index` (0 is first), counted among the slides that are not moving.

commands.name: slide.duplicate
commands.label: Duplicate slide
commands.description: Duplicate slides; each copy lands after the last of them. Returns { ids }.

commands.name: slide.hide
commands.label: Hide slide
commands.description: Hide or show slides: a hidden slide stays in the deck but present mode skips it. hidden defaults to toggling.

commands.name: slide.layout
commands.label: Layout
commands.description: Apply a layout (layout.list) to slides. Placeholder content moves into the new layout's placeholders of the same type; content with no place stays where it is.

commands.name: slide.notes
commands.label: Speaker notes
commands.description: Set a slide's speaker notes (plain text or rich Text). They show in the presenter view and in deck.read.

notes.description: Plain text (one paragraph per line; "- " starts a bullet, "1. " a numbered item) or a rich Text { paras: [{ runs: [{ t, b, i, u, s, color, size, font, hl, link }], list, level, align }] }

commands.name: slide.transition
commands.label: Transition
commands.description: Set the transition into slides: type none, fade or push, duration in ms (0–5000, default 400). all: true applies it to every slide.

commands.name: slide.background
commands.label: Background
commands.description: Set slide backgrounds: { color } (#rrggbb or a theme colour), { gradient: { type linear|radial, angle, stops: [{ at 0–1, color }] } }, { mediaId } for an image, or null for the theme background. all: true applies it to every slide.

commands.name: slide.go
commands.label: Go to slide
commands.description: Show a slide in the editor: by id, or by number n (1 is first). In master view, slide may also be _master or _L_<layout id>.

slide.description: Slide id, or _master or _L_<layout id> in master view

commands.name: slide.next
commands.label: Next slide
commands.description: Show the next slide in the editor (in master view, the next layout).

commands.name: slide.prev
commands.label: Previous slide
commands.description: Show the previous slide in the editor (in master view, the previous layout).

commands.name: element.add
commands.label: Add element
commands.description: Add an element to a slide (default: the current slide). kind is text, rect, roundrect, ellipse, triangle, line, arrow, image, table (rows, cols), icon. Element fields: x, y, w, h (stage px; the stage is deck.size, 1920x1080 for 16:9), rotation (degrees), opacity (0–1), locked, alt (alt text). Colours are #rrggbb, a theme colour (bg, text, heading, muted, accent1, accent2, accent3, accent4, accent5, accent6) or none. text, rect, roundrect, ellipse, triangle: text (see text.set), fill (colour or { gradient: { angle, stops: [{ at, color }] } }), stroke, strokeWidth (0–64), dash (solid|dashed|dotted), valign (top|middle|bottom), fit (none|shrink), padding; roundrect radius. line, arrow: stroke, strokeWidth, dash, flipH, flipV (the line runs from the box's top-left to its bottom-right unless flipped), startHead/endHead (none|arrow|triangle|dot). image: mediaId, crop { l, t, r, b } (fractions cut from each side), fit (cover|contain|fill). table: cells (rows of plain strings or { text, fill }), colWidths, rowHeights (fractions), headerRow, headerFill, fill, stroke, strokeWidth, fontSize. icon: props.icon is an icon name from icon.search ("lucide:sun", or a bare "sun", which tries Lucide then Tabler); Pellucia fills in its drawing and alt text. stroke (colour), strokeWidth, fill. text may be plain text. Returns { id }.

commands.name: element.update
commands.label: Change elements
commands.description: Change fields of elements (default: the selection). Element fields: x, y, w, h (stage px; the stage is deck.size, 1920x1080 for 16:9), rotation (degrees), opacity (0–1), locked, alt (alt text). Colours are #rrggbb, a theme colour (bg, text, heading, muted, accent1, accent2, accent3, accent4, accent5, accent6) or none. text, rect, roundrect, ellipse, triangle: text (see text.set), fill (colour or { gradient: { angle, stops: [{ at, color }] } }), stroke, strokeWidth (0–64), dash (solid|dashed|dotted), valign (top|middle|bottom), fit (none|shrink), padding; roundrect radius. line, arrow: stroke, strokeWidth, dash, flipH, flipV (the line runs from the box's top-left to its bottom-right unless flipped), startHead/endHead (none|arrow|triangle|dot). image: mediaId, crop { l, t, r, b } (fractions cut from each side), fit (cover|contain|fill). table: cells (rows of plain strings or { text, fill }), colWidths, rowHeights (fractions), headerRow, headerFill, fill, stroke, strokeWidth, fontSize. icon: props.icon is an icon name from icon.search ("lucide:sun", or a bare "sun", which tries Lucide then Tabler); Pellucia fills in its drawing and alt text. stroke (colour), strokeWidth, fill.

commands.name: element.move
commands.label: Move
commands.description: Move elements by dx, dy (stage px), or the first element to x, y (the rest keep their offsets). Grouped elements move together.

x.description: New left of the first element

y.description: New top of the first element

commands.name: element.resize
commands.label: Resize
commands.description: Give one element a new box (x, y, w, h; omitted values stay), or scale several from their joint box to `box`.

commands.name: element.rotate
commands.label: Rotate
commands.description: Rotate elements by `by` degrees, or to an absolute angle `to`.

commands.name: element.delete
commands.label: Delete
commands.description: Delete elements (default: the selection); grouped elements go together. Undo brings them back.

commands.name: element.duplicate
commands.label: Duplicate
commands.description: Duplicate elements, offset by dx, dy (default 24). Returns { ids }.

commands.name: element.group
commands.label: Group
commands.description: Group two or more elements on one slide, so they select and move together. Returns { group }.

commands.name: element.ungroup
commands.label: Ungroup
commands.description: Ungroup the innermost group of each element.

commands.name: element.order.front
commands.label: Bring to front
commands.description: Bring to front: change the drawing order of elements on their slide.

commands.name: element.order.forward
commands.label: Bring forward
commands.description: Bring forward: change the drawing order of elements on their slide.

commands.name: element.order.backward
commands.label: Send backward
commands.description: Send backward: change the drawing order of elements on their slide.

commands.name: element.order.back
commands.label: Send to back
commands.description: Send to back: change the drawing order of elements on their slide.

commands.name: element.align.left
commands.label: Align left
commands.description: Align left: align elements to each other, or one element to the slide (toSlide forces the slide).

toSlide.description: Align to the slide instead of the selection

commands.name: element.align.center
commands.label: Align centres
commands.description: Align centres: align elements to each other, or one element to the slide (toSlide forces the slide).

toSlide.description: Align to the slide instead of the selection

commands.name: element.align.right
commands.label: Align right
commands.description: Align right: align elements to each other, or one element to the slide (toSlide forces the slide).

toSlide.description: Align to the slide instead of the selection

commands.name: element.align.top
commands.label: Align top
commands.description: Align top: align elements to each other, or one element to the slide (toSlide forces the slide).

toSlide.description: Align to the slide instead of the selection

commands.name: element.align.middle
commands.label: Align middles
commands.description: Align middles: align elements to each other, or one element to the slide (toSlide forces the slide).

toSlide.description: Align to the slide instead of the selection

commands.name: element.align.bottom
commands.label: Align bottom
commands.description: Align bottom: align elements to each other, or one element to the slide (toSlide forces the slide).

toSlide.description: Align to the slide instead of the selection

commands.name: element.distribute
commands.label: Distribute
commands.description: Space three or more elements evenly along axis x or y.

commands.name: element.nudge.left
commands.label: Nudge left
commands.description: Move the selection left by `by` px (default 1; the keyboard uses 10 with Shift).

commands.name: element.nudge.right
commands.label: Nudge right
commands.description: Move the selection right by `by` px (default 1; the keyboard uses 10 with Shift).

commands.name: element.nudge.up
commands.label: Nudge up
commands.description: Move the selection up by `by` px (default 1; the keyboard uses 10 with Shift).

commands.name: element.nudge.down
commands.label: Nudge down
commands.description: Move the selection down by `by` px (default 1; the keyboard uses 10 with Shift).

commands.name: text.set
commands.label: Set text
commands.description: Replace the text of a text box or shape: plain text (one paragraph per line; "- " starts a bullet, "1. " a numbered item, two leading spaces per level) or a rich Text { paras: [{ runs: [{ t, b, i, u, s, color, size (px), font (heading|body|sans|serif|mono), hl, link }], list (bullet|number|null), level 0–4, align }] }.

text.description: Plain text (one paragraph per line; "- " starts a bullet, "1. " a numbered item) or a rich Text { paras: [{ runs: [{ t, b, i, u, s, color, size, font, hl, link }], list, level, align }] }

commands.name: text.format
commands.label: Format text
commands.description: Format all the text of elements: marks (b, i, u, s, color, size, font, hl, link; b/i/u/s true or false, size in px, color a colour, font heading|body|sans|serif|mono or a family, link a URL; null clears) and paragraph fields (list bullet|number|null, level 0–4, align left|center|right|justify, lineHeight, spaceBefore, spaceAfter). The editor formats a text selection itself.

commands.name: text.replace
commands.label: Replace text
commands.description: Replace every occurrence of `find` with `replace` in text boxes, shapes, tables and (with notes: true) speaker notes. Case-sensitive. Returns { count }.

commands.name: image.insert
commands.label: Picture…
commands.description: Insert a picture on a slide: dataUrl (data:image/png;base64,…) or url of a same-origin image. With no source, the person picks a file (needs a click). into fills a picture placeholder element. The image is downscaled to 2048 px and stored once. Returns { id, mediaId }.

into.description: An empty picture placeholder, or an empty content placeholder, element id

commands.name: table.cell
commands.label: Set cell
commands.description: Set one table cell: text (plain or rich) and/or fill (a colour, or null for none). row and col count from 0.

text.description: Plain text (one paragraph per line; "- " starts a bullet, "1. " a numbered item) or a rich Text { paras: [{ runs: [{ t, b, i, u, s, color, size, font, hl, link }], list, level, align }] }

commands.name: table.row_add
commands.label: Add row
commands.description: Insert a table row at `at` (default: at the end).

commands.name: table.row_delete
commands.label: Delete row
commands.description: Delete the table row at `at`.

commands.name: table.col_add
commands.label: Add column
commands.description: Insert a table column at `at` (default: at the end).

commands.name: table.col_delete
commands.label: Delete column
commands.description: Delete the table column at `at`.

commands.name: edit.copy
commands.label: Copy
commands.description: Copy elements to the clipboard.

commands.name: edit.cut
commands.label: Cut
commands.description: Cut elements to the clipboard.

commands.name: edit.paste
commands.label: Paste
commands.description: Paste elements, text or a picture onto the current slide.

commands.name: edit.undo
commands.label: Undo
commands.description: Undo the newest edit made by the caller (an agent undoes its own edits; the person's Undo skips agent edits). A change that was since overwritten is skipped, and the result says so.

commands.name: edit.redo
commands.label: Redo
commands.description: Redo the caller's newest undone edit.

commands.name: edit.select
commands.label: Select
commands.description: Select elements by id on the current slide (an empty list clears the selection).

commands.name: edit.select_all
commands.label: Select all
commands.description: Select every element on the current slide.

commands.name: view.zoom_fit
commands.label: Fit slide
commands.description: Zoom the editor so the slide fits.

commands.name: view.zoom_100
commands.label: Actual size
commands.description: Zoom the editor to 100%.

commands.name: view.zoom_in
commands.label: Zoom in
commands.description: Zoom the editor in.

commands.name: view.zoom_out
commands.label: Zoom out
commands.description: Zoom the editor out.

commands.name: view.sorter
commands.label: Slide sorter
commands.description: Show or hide the slide sorter: a grid of every slide to reorder and select.

commands.name: view.notes
commands.label: Notes pane
commands.description: Show or hide the speaker notes pane under the slide.

commands.name: present.start
commands.label: Present from start
commands.description: Present from start: present full screen from the first slide. Fullscreen needs a click or key press from a person; without one the slide fills the window.

commands.name: present.current
commands.label: Present from current slide
commands.description: Present from current slide: present full screen from the current slide. Fullscreen needs a click or key press from a person; without one the slide fills the window.

commands.name: present.presenter
commands.label: Presenter view
commands.description: Present with the presenter view in a second window (current and next slide, notes, timer, clock). Needs a click from a person; pop-ups must be allowed.

commands.name: present.stop
commands.label: Stop presenting
commands.description: Leave present mode.

commands.name: ai.outline
commands.label: Draft a deck…
commands.description: Draft slides from a topic or pasted notes with the NakliOS model: the model returns a plan of slides (layout, title, bullets, notes), shown for review, then added after the current slide as one undo step. count is the number of slides (default 6, at most 20). apply: true skips the review.

commands.name: ai.rewrite
commands.label: Rewrite…
commands.description: Rewrite the text of an element with the NakliOS model: how is shorter, clearer, formal, casual, or any instruction. Shown for review unless apply is true.

how.description: shorter, clearer, formal, casual, or an instruction

commands.name: ai.notes
commands.label: Draft notes
commands.description: Draft speaker notes for slides from their content with the NakliOS model. Shown for review unless apply is true.

commands.name: slide.reset
commands.label: Reset slide
commands.description: Reset slides to their layout, as PowerPoint's Reset does: placeholders return to the layout's position, size and formatting, and deleted placeholders come back empty. Text is kept.

commands.name: placeholder.fill
commands.label: Fill placeholder
commands.description: Put a table (rows, cols) or a chart into an empty content placeholder, taking its box; for a picture use image.insert with into. Returns { id }.

commands.name: layout.add
commands.label: Insert layout
commands.description: Add a layout to the deck (master view), copied from an existing layout (default Title and Content), with a name. Returns { id }.

commands.name: layout.update
commands.label: Layout settings
commands.description: Rename a layout, show or hide the master's graphics on it (showMaster), or set its background ({ color } | { gradient } | { mediaId } | null).

commands.name: layout.delete
commands.label: Delete layout
commands.description: Delete a layout no slide uses (undo brings it back).

commands.name: layout.move
commands.label: Move layout
commands.description: Move a layout to position `index` in the Layout menu (0 is first).

commands.name: layout.placeholder
commands.label: Insert placeholder
commands.description: Add a placeholder to a layout or the master (master view): type title, subtitle, body, content, picture, date, footer or slideNumber, with an optional box. Style it with element.update props.phStyle { font, size, bold, italic, color, align, valign, list, levels }. Returns { id }.

commands.name: master.set
commands.label: Master background
commands.description: Set the slide master's background, which every layout and slide inherits unless it sets its own.

commands.name: view.master
commands.label: Slide Master
commands.description: Open or close master view: edit the slide master and its layouts (placeholders, fixed elements, backgrounds). Elements there have slideId _master or _L_<layout id>; the element commands work on them with slide set to that id.

commands.name: template.list
commands.label: Templates
commands.description: The built-in templates: id, name, description and the number of sample slides.

commands.name: template.new
commands.label: New from template
commands.description: Start a new deck from a built-in template (template.list): its theme, master, all layouts and sample slides. The current deck stays in its file and the recovery copy.

commands.name: template.save
commands.label: Save as template…
commands.description: Save the deck's theme, master and layouts (and its slides as samples) as a template file (.pellucia with template: true) in NakliOS storage or a file you pick.

commands.name: template.open
commands.label: Open template…
commands.description: Start a new deck from a template file on this computer or in NakliOS storage.

commands.name: slide.section
commands.label: Section
commands.description: Start a named section at a slide (the rail groups slides under it), rename it, or remove it with name null.

name.description: Section name, or null to remove

commands.name: element.lock
commands.label: Lock
commands.description: Lock or unlock elements (default: toggle). A locked element cannot be selected by a click, moved or edited until unlocked.

commands.name: style.copy
commands.label: Copy style
commands.description: Format painter: copy the look of an element (fill, outline, shadow, text formatting) to paste onto others with style.paste.

commands.name: style.paste
commands.label: Paste style
commands.description: Format painter: put the copied look (style.copy, or `style` given here) onto elements.

commands.name: table.merge
commands.label: Merge cells
commands.description: Merge a rectangle of cells starting at row, col and spanning rows by cols; their text joins in the top-left cell.

commands.name: table.unmerge
commands.label: Split cells
commands.description: Split the merged range whose top-left cell is at row, col.

commands.name: image.replace
commands.label: Change picture…
commands.description: Replace a picture, keeping its box, crop and mask: dataUrl or a same-origin url; with no source a person picks a file.

id.description: Image element id (default: the selected picture)

commands.name: media.insert
commands.label: Video or audio…
commands.description: Insert a video or audio file on a slide (stored in the deck; plays while presenting): dataUrl or a same-origin url; with no source a person picks a file. Returns { id, mediaId }.

commands.name: font.add
commands.label: Add font…
commands.description: Add a font file (woff2, woff, ttf or otf) to the deck so text can use its family on every computer; dataUrl, or a person picks a file. Returns { family }.

family.description: Family name (default: from the file name)

commands.name: font.remove
commands.label: Remove font
commands.description: Remove a font the deck carries; text that used it falls back to the theme font.

commands.name: chartella.insert
commands.label: Chartella board…
commands.description: Insert a Chartella board or frame as a picture: a person picks a Chartella PNG or SVG export from NakliOS storage or this computer.

commands.name: view.grid
commands.label: Grid and guides
commands.description: Show the grid, snap to it, set its size in stage px, or set guides [{ axis x|y, at }]; saved with the deck. With no input it toggles the grid.

commands.name: view.rulers
commands.label: Rulers
commands.description: Show or hide the rulers.

commands.name: view.selection
commands.label: Selection pane
commands.description: Show or hide the selection pane: every element on the slide in drawing order, to select, rename, hide, lock and reorder.

commands.name: view.find
commands.label: Find and replace
commands.description: Open the find and replace bar (searches slides and notes).

commands.name: view.palette
commands.label: Command palette
commands.description: Open the command palette: type to find and run any command.

commands.name: view.animations
commands.label: Animation pane
commands.description: Show or hide the animation pane: the slide's builds in order, with their effects and timing.

commands.name: element.build
commands.label: Animate
commands.description: Give elements a build (null removes it): type entrance (appear, fade, zoom, wipe, fly, float, split), emphasis (pulse, grow, spin, teeter, tint) or exit (disappear, fade, zoom, fly); start click, with (the previous build) or after; by object or paragraph (bullet by bullet); duration and delay in ms; from left|right|top|bottom for fly and wipe. Builds run in `order`, lowest first; new builds go last.

build.description: { type, effect, start, by, duration, delay, from }

commands.name: build.order
commands.label: Reorder animations
commands.description: Set the order of a slide's builds: ids in the order they play.

ids.description: Element ids with builds, in play order

commands.name: slide.timing
commands.label: Slide timing
commands.description: Set rehearsed times (ms per slide; null clears): { timings: { slideId: ms } }. Rehearse Timings writes these.

commands.name: slide.advance
commands.label: Advance slide
commands.description: Advance slides automatically after `after` ms (null: only on a click), and whether a click also advances (onClick). all: true applies it to every slide.

onClick.description: Advance on a click too (default true)

commands.name: deck.show
commands.label: Set up slide show
commands.description: Slide show settings: loop (run until Esc, for a kiosk) and useTimings (advance by rehearsed timings and slide.advance).

commands.name: present.rehearse
commands.label: Rehearse timings
commands.description: Present from the start with a timer that records the time on each slide; at the end, keep the timings or not.

commands.name: deck.import
commands.label: Import…
commands.description: Import a PowerPoint (.pptx) or Markdown (Marp or Slidev .md) file as a new deck, with a list of what could not be kept.

commands.name: theme.import
commands.label: Import theme…
commands.description: Take the theme colours, fonts and layouts from a PowerPoint (.pptx) file a person picks, and apply them to this deck.

commands.name: ai.alt
commands.label: Write alt text
commands.description: Write alt text for pictures (default: the selected ones, else every picture without alt text) with the NakliOS model, when it can see images. Shown for review unless apply is true.

commands.name: ai.chat
commands.label: Chat
commands.description: Open the chat pane: ask the NakliOS model to change the deck; it uses these commands (or a JSON plan on models without tools), and each turn is one undo step.

commands.name: ai.image
commands.label: Generate picture
commands.description: Generate a picture from a prompt with the NakliOS model (only when it offers image generation) and put it in a picture or content placeholder (into) or on the slide.

commands.name: ai.restyle
commands.label: Suggest design
commands.description: Ask the NakliOS model for a better layout per slide and a theme for the deck; shown for review unless apply is true.

commands.name: ai.document
commands.label: Deck from document…
commands.description: Turn a document (text given here, or a file a person picks: .txt, .md, .html, or a Lectella source) into slides with notes; shown for review unless apply is true.

commands.name: deck.guide
commands.label: Agent guide
commands.description: How to edit a Pellucia deck well as an agent: the rules (read first, address by id, one change at a time, use layouts and theme tokens, never coordinates for placeholders) and the command habits.

commands.name: a11y.check
commands.label: Check accessibility
commands.description: Check the deck: pictures without alt text, slides without a title, duplicate titles, low-contrast text, empty placeholders, and reading order (the order a screen reader takes: the slide reading order, else drawing order). Returns [{ slide, element?, rule, message }].

commands.name: element.reading_order
commands.label: Reading order
commands.description: Set the reading order of a slide's elements (the order screen readers take), first read first; elements not listed follow in drawing order. Drawing order does not change (review P34). An empty list clears it.

slide.description: Slide id (default: the slide of the first id, or the current slide)

commands.name: script.run
commands.label: Run script
commands.description: Run a list of commands as one undo step: steps [{ command, input }]. A string "$N.key" in an input is step N's result field (1-based), e.g. "$1.id". If a step fails nothing changes. At most 200 steps.

commands.name: assistant.ask
commands.label: Ask…
commands.description: Ask Pellucia's assistant to do a job in the open deck (for example build, rewrite or format it). It opens the Ask pane, starts at once and returns a job id; follow it with assistant.status.

request.description: What to do, in plain words

commands.name: assistant.status
commands.label: Assistant status
commands.description: The state of Pellucia's assistant job (the latest when job is omitted): running, done, failed, stopped or limit, with its last steps and summary.

commands.name: assistant.stop
commands.label: Stop assistant
commands.description: Stop Pellucia's running assistant job.

commands.name: help.show
commands.label: Keyboard shortcuts
commands.description: Show every command and its keys.

errorCodes.meaning: The slide, element, layout, theme, media or command named does not exist.
The element is locked; unlock it first.
There is nothing to act on.
Something must be selected or made first.
The operation does not apply to this kind of element.
The file is not a deck Pellucia can read.
This browser or this page cannot do it (an API or the host is missing).
A colour is not one Pellucia accepts (#rrggbb, #rgb, #rrggbbaa, a theme colour or none).
A number is outside its allowed range.
A value is not one of the allowed choices or has the wrong form.
